title: Sign-in with a wrong password shows the generic error
expected: Stays on /login, shows "Invalid email or password."
actual: Stayed on /login with "Invalid email or password."

title: Sign-in form client validation (empty fields, malformed email)
expected: Sign-in button disabled while a field is empty; email input flags a malformed address
actual: Email/password are required, button disabled when empty; email validationMessage "Please include an '@'..."
evidence: LoginPage form noValidate + disabled button; checkValidity()=false

title: Successful sign-in (viewer) lands on the Market Overview
expected: Redirect to /, overview tiles render, demo-data banner shown
actual: Overview with 10 futures tiles and FX, demo banner, "Data as of 18 Nov 2026"

title: Deep link while signed out returns to the page after sign-in
expected: /admin/users -> /login?next=%2Fadmin%2Fusers -> after sign-in back on /admin/users
actual: Redirected to /login?next=%2Fadmin%2Fusers, then /admin/users after admin sign-in

title: Sign out from the user menu
expected: Back on /login, CSRF cookie cleared, /api/auth/me 401

title: Server-side session revocation sends the SPA to the sign-in page
expected: After an admin revokes the user's sessions, the next navigation goes to /login?next=...

title: Disabled user is signed out and cannot sign in again
expected: Open SPA session ends (401 -> /login); sign-in shows the generic error
actual: /me 401, redirected to /login; sign-in shows "Invalid email or password."

title: Login page shows only the enabled sign-in method (AUTH-03)
expected: No "Sign in with Downstream Hub" button while SSO is disabled
actual: Only the email/password form is shown

title: Change password: rule checklist and confirm-mismatch hint keep Save disabled
expected: Save disabled for mismatch, weak password and empty current password; mismatch hint shown
actual: mismatch: disabled + hint; weak: disabled, rules 1-2 red; empty current: disabled

title: Change password: wrong current password shows the server error
expected: Alert "Your current password is incorrect."

title: Change password: valid change returns to the overview
expected: 200, navigate to /

title: Change password submit handler re-checks the form rules
expected: A programmatic/implicit submit with confirm != new is refused client-side (submit handler checks `valid`)
actual: form.requestSubmit() with mismatched confirmation sent the request and the password was changed (200); only the disabled Save button guards it
evidence: network: 200 POST /api/auth/change-password with confirm mismatch; ChangePasswordPage.tsx submit() has no `valid` check. Not reachable by a normal click/Enter (default button disabled) — hardening only.

title: Viewer sidebar lists only permitted modules
expected: Overview, Outright Prices, Calendar Spreads, Product Spreads, Parity; no admin, Waste/Bio or intel entries

title: Viewer: permitted pages render with charts
expected: Outright, Outright forward, Calendar Spreads (+forward, YTD), Product Spreads, Parity Malindo, Parity Ind/China render charts

title: Viewer: forbidden pages show the 403 state and call no data APIs
expected: Waste/Bio (section, curves, YTD), Tradable Prem, CFTC, AI, SND, Atlas, News, Calendar, OI, TA, Crush, every admin page -> "403 You don't have access"
actual: All 17 routes show the 403 card; no API errors logged

title: Unknown route shows the 404 page
expected: /no/such/page and /waste-bio/curves/bogus -> "404 Page not found"

title: Unknown module code shows 404, not 403 (admin)
expected: /m/nope_module for an administrator -> 404 Page not found
actual: "403 You don't have access to this module" with title "Module · AASTAR"
evidence: ModuleShell/ModulePage treat any code missing from the catalog as forbidden

title: Admin: every analytics page renders without console errors
expected: Overview, Outright (+forward), Calendar Spreads (+forward, YTD), Product Spreads (+forward), Basis, Tradable Prem, Parity, Ind/China, Crush, Leading Signals render

title: Admin: Waste/Bio sub-navigation (12 sections, 3 forward-curve sets, YTD)
expected: /m/waste_bio redirects to calendar; each sub-section and curve set renders
actual: Redirect ok; calendar 3, curves/calendar 6, ytd 6, product 3, curves/product 19, outright 5, premium 9, fwd_diff 6, bunker 3, margin 3, byproduct 2, freight 2, tickets 6, arb 1, features 3, us 4 plots

title: Admin: OI/Volume, TA, CFTC, SND (3 views), Atlas, AI, News, Calendar render
expected: Each page renders its content or a clear empty / not-configured state
actual: OI tables, TA chart, CFTC (empty + job state), SND no-data, Atlas map (179 paths) + 91 rows, AI and Calendar 'Claude is not configured', News 3 plots

title: Admin console pages render (users, roles, pipeline, sheets, audit, settings)
expected: All six pages render with data

title: Legacy /forward-curves redirects to Outright Prices · Forward Curve
expected: /forward-curves -> /m/outright_prices/forward

title: Analyst sees Data pipeline but not the other admin pages
expected: Sidebar admin section = Data pipeline only; /admin/users and /admin/sheets show 403; SND upload hidden

title: Browser tab title follows the page (login, change password)
expected: Title names the current page (e.g. "Sign in · AASTAR", "Change password · AASTAR")
actual: Title keeps the previous page's title: /change-password showed "Settings · AASTAR" / "Not found · AASTAR"; /login showed "Market Overview · AASTAR"

title: New user dialog: Register disabled until email and name are filled; defaults Viewer + Hub SSO
expected: Register disabled when empty; role viewer, method sso by default

title: New user dialog: whitespace-only display name is refused
expected: Register stays disabled (or server 422) for a name of spaces
actual: Register enabled for '   '; the API accepts it and stores an empty display name (see FT-USR-09)

title: New user dialog: server validation errors name the field
expected: For an invalid email the dialog says which field is wrong

title: New user dialog: duplicate email shows the conflict message
expected: "A user with this email already exists."

title: Register an SSO viewer with a module grant
expected: Dialog closes; user listed with provider sso, override grant crush, effective modules include crush

title: Edit dialog: switching an SSO user to Password without a password shows the server rule
expected: "Reset the password first to enable password sign-in for this user."

title: Edit dialog: Disable asks for confirmation and disables the user
expected: confirm("Disable <email>? ...") then status disabled
actual: Confirm text shown; user disabled; dialog closed

title: Roles matrix: admin column locked; Save enabled only when dirty; change persists and restores
expected: 18 admin checkboxes disabled; Save disabled until a change; viewer+crush saved then removed
actual: As expected; viewer modules restored to the original 6

title: Settings: out-of-range and empty idle timeout show the server message; valid change saved and restored
expected: 4 / empty -> "must be between 5 and 240"; 45 saved; restored to 30

title: Sheet sources: service-account key validation messages
expected: Save key disabled for short text; wrong type and invalid JSON show the server message; nothing stored

title: Sheet sources: corrupt .xlsx upload shows an error and stores nothing
expected: "The file could not be read as an Excel workbook."; upload stays null

title: Sheet sources / CFTC: refresh buttons while a job is queued
expected: "Refreshing…" with refresh disabled while a job is queued (no worker on this stack)
actual: As expected (jobs stay queued because the worker is intentionally not running)

title: Audit log: action filter and CSV link follow the filter
expected: Only USER_DISABLE rows; Export CSV href carries action=USER_DISABLE

title: Data pipeline page: queued run listed and run buttons disabled while busy
expected: Queued recompute in history; Run refresh / Recompute disabled

title: AI Analysis: run an analysis without Claude
expected: Run enabled after choosing an instrument; sections and charts render; not-configured note

title: Atlas: filters and search
expected: Cancelled hidden by default (91 of 94); search 'Panama' -> 1 row

title: Atlas: search with no match shows an empty-state message (DASH-14)
expected: "No plants match" (or similar) instead of an empty table

title: Global controls persist per user (DASH-01)
expected: Unit toggle and year selection stored in localStorage (aastar.unit / aastar.years)
actual: aastar.unit="local", aastar.years=[2025,2026] after toggling; restored to usd / [2024,2025,2026]

title: Mobile layout (375 px): hamburger navigation, no horizontal scroll
expected: Hamburger opens the sidebar, closes after navigation, no horizontal scroll
actual: Viewport emulation did not apply to the running page (innerWidth stayed 712 px) — inconclusive
